meta.methodology: OctaSpace prices are live averages of current marketplace asking prices, refreshed in your browser. Competitor prices are verified on the dates shown. vast.name: Vast.ai
vast.note: Index of verified-host listings refreshed from the madebyagents.com GPU-rental price index, which aggregates the Vast.ai public API — figures are pulled via that third-party index, not queried from Vast.ai directly. Vast.ai figures are the cheapest offer found ('from' prices, spot tier) — the marketplace moves hourly, so treat these as directional. Pulled 2026-09-30 ~22:50 UTC (index page modified 10:48 PM UTC). 7 moved this pull: 3090 $0.09->$0.07, 4070 $0.07->$0.09, 4090 $0.22->$0.20, 5070 $0.12->$0.11, 5080 $0.16->$0.17, 5090 $0.27->$0.29, H100 SXM $1.07->$0.67. RTX 4080 cell retains the 16:50 UTC pull ($0.18): this pull has no Vast.ai spot row for that SKU. RTX A6000 cell retains the 2026-09-28 pull ($0.13): no Vast.ai spot row for that SKU this pull. A100 cell retains the 2026-09-27 snapshot ($0.75): no matching 40GB SXM4 spot row (this pull lists only 80GB PCIe $0.19 / 80GB SXM $0.35). H100 SXM $0.67 is the index table's h100-sxm Vast.ai Spot 'Cheapest Offer' row (the table now splits SXM/NVL variants; featured-card $1.73 headline ignored per methodology).
